svg.title: One foundation. Repeatable agent releases.
svg.desc: Two connected workflows. The Private foundation lane uses Terraform and Azure Verified Modules: step 1 reviews the plan for permissions, quota, cost approval, and protected remote state; step 2 provisions separate Foundry platform and Lab roots with optional Bastion and monitoring; step 3 verifies private access, network paths, identities, and the intended environment. A data handoff passes the project endpoint, model deployments, identity, and private connectivity to agent releases; a bundle does not carry Azure permissions, infrastructure, or saved records. The Agent releases lane uses reviewed code, instructions, and versioned configuration: step 4 packages source and a configuration manifest while keeping deployment mappings explicit; step 5 publishes a new hosted version and checks the documented release gates; step 6 routes, reviews, and iterates by checking answers against evidence and using guarded recovery. People approve infrastructure changes, publication costs, and business decisions. This is a logical workflow only; the CLI and Lab release paths have different gates, and a code push is not a deployment.
svg.text: Prepare private infrastructure once, then release agents through an explicit configuration handoff. Numbers follow the six steps.
